objects.description: During the [AI-Assisted Breach of Mexico's Government Infrastructure](https://attack.mitre.org/campaigns/C0064), the adversary tasked Claude Code to escalate privileges by modifying a crontab script to inject an SSH key into root’s `authorized_keys` file and then restore the file modification time, so the crontab script appeared unchanged.(Citation: AI-Mexico-Govt-Breach)
